newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA SEPT TRACTOR SALES UP 65 PCT YR/YR.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA SEPT TRACTOR SALES UP 65 PCT YR/YR.

text.p: South African tractor sales surged 65 percent in September to 562 from 341 a year ago as farmers continued to re-equip on the back of expected strong earnings following this year's bumper harvest.
Tractor sales in the year to date now total 4,396 units against 3,123 in the same nine months of 1995, the South Afican Agricultural Machinery Association (Saama) said.
Saama said continuing good sales would depend on an average or good start to the coming summer rain season. It added that tractor sales in 1996 now looked to be around 6,000 units.
